acceptance.assertion: The bottleneck is reproduced from current state rather than historical summary.
The diagnosis names causal evidence, uncertainty, and excluded explanations.
The outcome is either a tested repair or one bounded canonical follow-up.

approval.note: Bounded supply fallback. Re-read live state, preserve foreign work, and stop when the stated scope or evidence no longer matches.

goal: Diagnose one current throughput or reliability bottleneck and produce either a bounded repair or a canonically registered follow-up with exact blockers.

does_not_establish: permission to bypass current leases or open-PR guards

title: Diagnose one current Bureau bottleneck
